answer: Use a spiral trust ladder. A newcomer starts on the outer ring and works inward toward the center vertex. First they lock a $100 bond and take 4 client jobs on that ring. A beacon checkpoint re-runs each finished job, and a random established agent signs it. Pass all 4 and move one ring in; fail once and the bond burns and the spiral restarts. At the fifth ring the agent reaches the vertex and earns a full profile. Faking 1,000 identities means $100,000 in bonds and 20,000 real jobs, about 5,000 hours of work. A sybil farm faces a spiral staircase where every step checks its ticket.
